name: ruff
description: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter

name: -h
--help
options.description: Print help

name: -V
--version
options.description: Print version

name: -v
--verbose
options.description: Enable verbose logging

name: -q
--quiet
options.description: Print diagnostics, but nothing else

name: -s
--silent
options.description: Disable all logging (still exits with status code "1" upon detecting diagnostics)

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to a TOML config file (pyproject.toml or ruff.toml), or a "<KEY> = <VALUE>" pair overriding a specific option

options.name: --isolated
options.description: Ignore all configuration files

options.name: --color
options.description: Control when colored output is used

subcommands.name: check
subcommands.description: Run Ruff on the given files or directories

options.name: --fix
options.description: Apply fixes to resolve lint violations (use --unsafe-fixes to include unsafe fixes)

options.name: --no-fix
options.description: Disable applying fixes (disables --fix)

options.name: --unsafe-fixes
options.description: Include fixes that may not retain the original intent of the code

options.name: --no-unsafe-fixes
options.description: Disable unsafe fixes (disables --unsafe-fixes)

options.name: --show-fixes
options.description: Show an enumeration of all fixed lint violations

options.name: --no-show-fixes
options.description: Disable showing an enumeration of fixed lint violations (disables --show-fixes)

options.name: --fix-only
options.description: Apply fixes without reporting on, or exiting non-zero for, leftover violations (implies --fix)

options.name: --no-fix-only
options.description: Disable fix-only mode (disables --fix-only)

options.name: --diff
options.description: Avoid writing fixed files back; output a diff for each changed file to stdout instead (implies --fix-only)

name: -w
--watch
options.description: Run in watch mode by re-running whenever files change

options.name: --ignore-noqa
options.description: Ignore any `# noqa` comments

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Output serialization format for violations (default: full)

name: -o
--output-file
options.description: File to write the linter output to (default: stdout)

options.name: --target-version
options.description: The minimum Python version that should be supported

options.name: --preview
options.description: Enable preview mode; checks include unstable rules and fixes

options.name: --no-preview
options.description: Disable preview mode (disables --preview)

options.name: --extension
options.description: Map a file extension to a language (python, ipynb, or pyi), e.g. "ipy:ipynb"

options.name: --statistics
options.description: Show counts for every rule with at least one violation

options.name: --add-noqa
options.description: Add `noqa` directives to failing lines instead of reporting them

options.name: --add-ignore
options.description: Add `ruff: ignore` comments to failing lines instead of reporting them

options.name: --show-files
options.description: See the files Ruff will be run against with the current settings

options.name: --show-settings
options.description: See the settings Ruff will use to lint a given Python file

options.name: --select
options.description: Comma-separated list of rule codes to enable (or ALL, to enable all rules)

options.name: --ignore
options.description: Comma-separated list of rule codes to disable

options.name: --extend-select
options.description: Like --select, but adds additional rule codes on top of those already specified

options.name: --per-file-ignores
options.description: List of mappings from file pattern to rule codes to exclude

options.name: --extend-per-file-ignores
options.description: Like --per-file-ignores, but adds additional ignores on top of those already specified

options.name: --fixable
options.description: List of rule codes to treat as eligible for fix (only applies when fix is enabled)

options.name: --unfixable
options.description: List of rule codes to treat as ineligible for fix (only applies when fix is enabled)

options.name: --extend-fixable
options.description: Like --fixable, but adds additional rule codes on top of those already specified

options.name: --exclude
options.description: List of paths used to omit files and/or directories from analysis

options.name: --extend-exclude
options.description: Like --exclude, but adds additional files and directories on top of those already excluded

options.name: --respect-gitignore
options.description: Respect file exclusions via .gitignore and other standard ignore files

options.name: --no-respect-gitignore
options.description: Ignore .gitignore and other standard ignore files (disables --respect-gitignore)

options.name: --force-exclude
options.description: Enforce exclusions, even for paths passed directly on the command line

options.name: --no-force-exclude
options.description: Disable enforcing exclusions for paths passed directly on the command line (disables --force-exclude)

name: -n
--no-cache
options.description: Disable cache reads

options.name: --cache-dir
options.description: Path to the cache directory

options.name: --stdin-filename
options.description: The name of the file when passing it through stdin

name: -e
--exit-zero
options.description: Exit with status code "0", even upon detecting lint violations

options.name: --exit-non-zero-on-fix
options.description: Exit with a non-zero status code if any files were modified via fix, even if no violations remain

args.name: files
args.description: Files or directories to check, or "-" to read from stdin (default: .)

subcommands.name: format
subcommands.description: Run the Ruff formatter on the given files or directories

options.name: --check
options.description: Avoid writing formatted files back; exit non-zero if any files would be modified

options.name: --diff
options.description: Avoid writing formatted files back; exit non-zero and print the diff for each file

options.name: --extension
options.description: Map a file extension to a language (python, ipynb, or pyi), e.g. "ipy:ipynb"

options.name: --target-version
options.description: The minimum Python version that should be supported

options.name: --preview
options.description: Enable preview mode; enables unstable formatting

options.name: --no-preview
options.description: Disable preview mode (disables --preview)

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Output serialization format for violations, when used with --check (default: full)

name: -n
--no-cache
options.description: Disable cache reads

options.name: --cache-dir
options.description: Path to the cache directory

options.name: --stdin-filename
options.description: The name of the file when passing it through stdin

options.name: --exit-non-zero-on-format
options.description: Exit with a non-zero status code if any files were modified via format

options.name: --respect-gitignore
options.description: Respect file exclusions via .gitignore and other standard ignore files

options.name: --no-respect-gitignore
options.description: Ignore .gitignore and other standard ignore files (disables --respect-gitignore)

options.name: --exclude
options.description: List of paths used to omit files and/or directories from analysis

options.name: --extend-exclude
options.description: Like --exclude, but adds additional files and directories on top of those already excluded

options.name: --force-exclude
options.description: Enforce exclusions, even for paths passed directly on the command line

options.name: --no-force-exclude
options.description: Disable enforcing exclusions for paths passed directly on the command line (disables --force-exclude)

options.name: --line-length
options.description: Set the line length

options.name: --range
options.description: Only format the code in the given range, e.g. "<start_line>:<start_column>-<end_line>:<end_column>" (single file only)
